title: Create unified useProgress hook
description: Create a useProgress() hook that abstracts the data source - using localStorage for anonymous users and Convex for authenticated users. This provides a single interface for all progress operations regardless of auth state.
acceptanceCriteria: Hook checks auth state via authClient.useSession()
Anonymous users: all operations go to localStorage via useAnonymousProgress
Authenticated users: all operations go to Convex via existing mutations
Same return interface for both paths: { wordProgress, lineProgress, toggleWordLearned, toggleLineLearned, ... }
No loading flicker when switching between states
technicalNotes: Return unified interface with consistent method signatures
Handle the auth loading state gracefully
testingNotes: Unit test: returns localStorage operations when not authenticated
Unit test: returns Convex operations when authenticated
Integration test: switching auth state switches data source
